spans.s: DG0086 गुण guṇa properties of a substance; present in the substance as a co inherent factor to perform a definite set of actions; might be physical, chemical, pharmacological, etc. but mainly pertains to the pharmacological properties.
BK0050 गुणसञ्चयम् guṇasañcayam Accumulation of properties- during the preparation of oil, ghee, guda & fermented products.
BP0104 गुणान्तराधानम् guṇāntarādhānam modulation of property
AF0817 गुण्ठनं guṇṭhanaṁ Hiding of head
